# Invest with Saad (https://www.saadtherealtor.com)

> Multifamily investment advisor for small-scale investors in the Capital Region (NY) and Jacksonville (FL). Provides deal analysis education, market insights, and portfolio strategy resources.

## Website
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com: Main site with investment guidance and tools
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/buying: Buying guidance and deal analysis frameworks
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/selling: Selling resources and exit planning
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/blog: 15+ articles on deal analysis, market comparisons, investment strategies
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/how-to: 6 educational guides (1031 exchanges, market selection, deal evaluation, cap rate analysis)
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/calculator: Investment analysis tools (affordability, mortgage calculations)
- https://www.saadtherealtor.com/faq: Investor FAQs on deal evaluation and market strategy

## Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
- **Scaling Investors**: Own 5-10+ multifamily units, evaluating acquisitions and exits
- **Accidental Owners**: Inherited or accumulated rental properties (2-6 units)
- **Capital Recyclers**: Selling properties and exploring 1031 exchange strategies
- **First-Time Multifamily Investors**: Transitioning from single-family to multifamily

## What's Documented On Site
- **Deal Analysis**: Cap rate calculations, cash flow modeling, NOI analysis, quick screening frameworks
- **Market Intelligence**: Capital Region market comparisons (Schenectady vs Albany), appreciation data, rent trends
- **Tax Strategy**: 1031 exchange guides, capital gains planning, portfolio optimization
- **Investment Education**: Deal evaluation guides, property analysis frameworks, market selection criteria
- **Calculators & Tools**: Cap rate projections, cash flow modeling, mortgage analysis, affordability planning
